policy: Only recordings with an explicit reusable licence are served locally. Reference-only items must not be downloaded or re-hosted. No YouTube extraction, fabricated instrument cue or unlicensed substitution is permitted.
rightsSeparation: MIT applies to source code only. Each media/content item retains the terms recorded in CREDITS.md and public/media/audio-manifest.json; community cultural rights are not relicensed by the code licence.

runtimeAudio.interactionAudioPolicy: Hotspots play only licensed real recordings or provide reference-only official links. Browser-synthesized object cues were removed.
runtimeAudio.implementation: The six neutral backgrounds are synthesized in-browser by MIT-licensed generator code with no external samples; licensed hotspot recordings are listed in public/media/audio-manifest.json.
runtimeAudio.culturalBoundary: Modern neutral background score only; not heritage music, ritual sound, a community field recording, or a claim about craft technique.
